response.note: The question is ambiguous (no baseline period or segment given), so this shows the top failure categories and codes for October 2026 as a starting point; assumes successful attempts have status = 'SUCCESS'.
response.sql: SELECT failure_category, failure_code, COUNT(*) AS failed_attempts FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01' AND status <> 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY failure_category, failure_code ORDER BY failed_attempts DESC LIMIT 50
